turns.text: Make a square poster: a little illustrated coffee cup in the bottom half, cream background, dark brown headline 'SLOW SUNDAY' centred near the top. Plenty of space around the headline. No other words.

item.tests: Tests whether enlarging text reuses the existing illustration and changes only the text overlay, without regenerating or paying for the artwork again.

answer_sheet.How much bigger: Approximately 150% of the original font size.
answer_sheet.Font, colour and placement: Keep the original font and dark brown colour, with the headline centred on its original centre point.
answer_sheet.Size and illustration style: Square, 640 by 640 pixels. Illustration style is your call.
answer_sheet.Other changes: None. Keep the coffee cup, background and all other artwork unchanged.

must_haves: The headline reads exactly 'SLOW SUNDAY', with no other words.
The headline is approximately 1.5 times its original font size and remains fully inside the canvas.
The headline retains its original font, dark brown colour and centre point.
The coffee cup illustration and cream background are unchanged from the first output.
